settings.title: Settings
settings.defaultsHint: Changing the defaults does not affect existing projects (DEF-005).
settings.backupRetentionHint: 1–200. Zero is not allowed: writing without a backup is forbidden (BKP-005). Default 10 per file (D-17).
settings.exclusionsInputLabel: Add a folder name to the exclusion list
settings.exclusionsHint: Folders with these names are skipped at any depth (D-05).
settings.updatesHint: Updates come from GitHub Releases through the signed Tauri updater (UPD-002, D-27).
settings.statusLine: Settings are applied immediately — there is no Save button.

error.backupRetention: Backup limit: an integer from 1 to 200 (§6.5).
error.scanDepth: Scan depth: an integer from 1 to 20 (§6.5).
error.historyRevisions: Versions per entity: an integer from 10 to 1000 (§6.5).
error.logEntries: Log entries: an integer from 1000 to 100000 (§6.5).
error.logDays: Log days: an integer from 7 to 3650 (§6.5).
